summary: npm package resolves dependency from arbitrary Cloudflare Workers URL instead of the npm registry
details: package.json at line 12 declares the dependency 'lexer-batch-filter-render' with its source set to the HTTPS URL https://package-registry-receiver-stg.depx-research-bf0.workers.dev/npm/lexer-batch-filter-render rather than a semver range resolved from the npm registry. On npm install, the client fetches whatever bytes that Cloudflare Workers endpoint returns and installs them, running any lifecycle scripts they contain. The content is unpinned, has no integrity hash, and the host is operator-controllable and unrelated to any declared repository or publisher for this package. The shipped index.js is a thin stub that re-exports that dependency, so the manifest URL effectively defines the entire runtime behavior of the package. The dependency name does not match any established npm library and the host is not an npm registry mirror.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
